diagnostic_instance.purpose: First deterministic current-canonical background construction attempt under a fixed information budget; not an observationally selected or physically preferred point.

forbidden_adaptation: changing any model parameter other than h-controlled a_F
selecting a different seed after seeing residuals
accepting a branch that does not reach h=1
control_homotopy.failure_rule: If h=0 cannot be closed or any continuation interval fails after deterministic bisection to 1/256, the attempt is classified NO_ACCEPTED_CANDIDATE.

exact_identities: E_A=E_ell=E_varphi=E_gauge=0 in both bulk regions at h=0
C_rr=0 in both bulk regions at h=0
exact_bulk_control_seed.role: Deterministic initial iterate for closing the full h=0 cap system; the displayed nonzero cap defects may not be hidden or relabeled as numerical error.

primary_backend.coordinate: tau in [0,1] independently on north and south regions
primary_backend.discrete_square_count: 8*(N+1)+8 unknowns and the same number of regularized bulk plus cap residuals
primary_backend.pole_treatment: Use the exact tau=0 continuous extensions frozen in Operator-2B; no pole cutoff in the primary backend.

nonlinear_iteration.relative_SVD_cutoff: 1e-12 for solve stabilization only; singular spectrum must be reported untruncated

determinism.linear_algebra_report: full singular values condition estimate and effective numerical rank

independent_backend.initialization: Operator-2A pole series through A4 ell5 varphi4 a_chi4
independent_backend.boundary_root_method: damped Newton with centered finite-difference Jacobian
independent_backend.reuse_of_primary_discrete_profiles: FORBIDDEN except as interpolated initial guess after primary candidate exists
independent_backend.role: Independent discretization and pole treatment cross-check; not a second physical confirmation.

residual_and_error_norms.raw_bulk: For each of F_A F_ell F_varphi F_gauge report the maximum absolute residual over both regions.
residual_and_error_norms.bulk_backward_error: At each node divide |F_i| by 1 plus the sum of absolute magnitudes of all additive terms in the same residual, then take the global maximum.
residual_and_error_norms.raw_boundary: Report all eight cap residuals in frozen order without rescaling.
residual_and_error_norms.boundary_backward_error: For each boundary residual divide its absolute value by 1 plus the sum of absolute magnitudes of its additive terms, then take the maximum.
residual_and_error_norms.constraint_backward_error: Evaluate C_rr/ell with its continuous pole extension and divide by 1 plus the sum of absolute magnitudes of its additive terms.
residual_and_error_norms.profile_difference: Maximum over tau and all eight chart profiles of |u_high-u_low|/(1+max(|u_high|,|u_low|)).
residual_and_error_norms.parameter_difference: Maximum over the eight augmented parameters of |p_high-p_low|/(1+max(|p_high|,|p_low|)).
residual_and_error_norms.spectral_tail: For each profile divide the l2 norm of the highest eight Chebyshev coefficients by 1 plus the l2 norm of all coefficients; report the maximum.

required_primary_conditions.admissibility: rho_N rho_S positive and min Lhat_N min Lhat_S greater than 1e-6

mandatory_reports: complete target parameter and sector record
complete continuation history including rejected steps
all raw and normalized residual components
all primary Jacobian singular values at accepted target candidate
SHA256 hashes of result tables and code entry points
prohibited_acceptance_practices: rounding a failed threshold into a pass
accepting only the best mesh or cutoff while hiding failures
tuning model parameters or integer sector after execution

execution_protocol.stage_0: Verify the exact H0 bulk seed identities and record its three nonzero cap defects.
execution_protocol.stage_1: At a_F=0 solve only the full eight-residual cap-coupled control BVP from the unique registered seed.
execution_protocol.stage_2: Continue a_F from 0 to 1/4 using the frozen h schedule and deterministic bisection rule.
execution_protocol.stage_3: At h=1 refine the primary solution at N=48 64 and 96 without parameter changes.
execution_protocol.stage_4: Run the independent x-space multiple-shooting backend at all three pole cutoffs.
execution_protocol.stage_5: Apply every acceptance condition jointly and issue exactly one final classification.

forbidden_inferences: The exact H0 bulk seed is not a solution of the full cap-coupled BVP.
Method preregistration does not establish that a numerical candidate exists.
A later accepted numerical candidate would not by itself prove continuum existence or uniqueness.
Two numerical backends would provide numerical QA, not independent physical confirmation.
No physical observable fit, stability, ghost-freedom, K1-D or K1-E result follows.
